headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to speed up permit approvals for building data centers and related infrastructure.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to move faster on the permits needed to build data centers and the infrastructure that supports them. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, rules, or deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that build or run data centers
who_it_affects.how: They may get federal permits for new projects more quickly.
They are directed to speed up their review of data center projects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 23, 2025; specific deadlines not stated in the provided material.
